| Defenders | Aaron Wan-Bissaka, Harry Maguire, Raphael Varane, Luke Shaw, Diogo Dalot, Eric Bailly, Ben White, Luke Ayling, Jadon Sancho (wing‑back) |
| Midfielders | Bruno Fernandes, Paul Pogba, Mason Greenwood, Scott McTominay, Fred, Donny van de Beek, Jadon Sancho (wing‑back), Nuno Mendes, Alejandro Garnacho |

* The list reflects the 2023‑24 season; transfers, loans, and injuries may have altered the lineup since then.

If you need the exact 2026‑27 roster, let me know and I can point you toward the official club resources or a live sports API that will give you the most up‑to‑date information.
